99.8% of 1200 frequency-matched RANDOM unrelated word pairs clear the orthogonality bar of VIF < 1.05 (the gate needs FEWER than 50% to clear, otherwise it separates nothing). Null median VIF 1.000032.

VIF(SALAT, ZAKAT) = 1.000028 (r = -0.005302) across 6236 ayahs. It sits at the 46.2th percentile of the frequency-matched null, i.e. 53.8% of RANDOM unrelated word pairs are at least as 'orthogonal'. Null median 1.000032.
28 of 28 pairs among the 8 declared tracks clear VIF < 1.05 (100.0%). Every pair, related or not, looks 'orthogonal'.
groups named by a finite verb using the SAME matcher that scored 7 of 7 control proper nouns at zero: S-L-M (aslama forms) 1 times; A-M-N (amanu forms) 268 times. Each needs >= 5.

EXCLUDED. It is not. The yeast (1.0026) and GitHub (1.0203) VIFs were computed on CONTINUOUS PER-NODE FEATURES where every unit has a real value on both axes and collinearity is a live possibility. Per-ayah word counts are overwhelmingly zero. Sharing a name does not make the quantities comparable and no number here may be reported beside them as if it did.
EXCLUDED and OUT OF SCOPE. The units are word-forms in one text. Nothing establishes what any word means, and nothing is a claim about Jewish, Christian or Muslim people, communities or beliefs.

model: Does a VIF gate carry information on Quranic word counts?

D1_THE_QUOTED_FIGURE_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE.note: A near-1.0 VIF on this substrate is what arbitrary unrelated word pairs produce, because two rare tracks are both nearly all zeros across 6,236 ayahs and r is near 0 whatever the words mean. The figure supports no claim about how the text handles anything.

D2_WHAT_SURVIVES_AND_IT_IS_NOT_THE_VIF.note: The DESIGNATION test does discriminate -- it scored 7 of 7 control proper nouns at zero in spec 708ac80e. Applied here it finds the S-L-M and A-M-N groups named by finite verbs. That is a real distributional fact; the VIF is not.

D3_the_category_difference.note: Yeast 1.0026 and GitHub 1.0203 were computed on continuous per-node features. Quoting a word-count VIF alongside them implies a comparability that does not exist.

D4_what_none_of_this_licenses.note: Distributional independence of two word-tracks would not be evidence of authorial architecture even if it had been found. No claim here concerns what any word means or any living community.

primary_verdict: THE VIF GATE DOES NOT DISCRIMINATE ON THIS SUBSTRATE: 99.8% of random unrelated word pairs clear VIF < 1.05. The measured Salat/Zakat VIF of 1.000028 sits at the 46.2th percentile of that null. A near-1.0 VIF here is forced by sparsity and supports nothing.
